balance.description: Output only. Converted balance in base currency cents.

rate.description: Output only. Exchange rate multiplier used.

AccountConversion.description: Conversion contains hydrated conversion metrics relative to the workspace base currency.

BorrowingDirection.description:
BorrowingDirection defines the type/direction of personal debt agreements.

 - BORROWED: Funds borrowed from an external entity (payable liability).
 - LENT: Funds lent to an external entity (receivable asset).

startDate.description: Output only. Start date boundary of the current period.

endDate.description: Output only. End date boundary of the current period.

spentAmount.description: Output only. Amount spent in local currency cents within this period.

spentInBase.description: Output only. Amount spent converted to base currency cents.

exchangeRateToBase.description: Output only. Exchange rate to base currency used during conversion.

limitInBase.description: Output only. Limit in base currency cents.

BudgetActivePeriod.description: Represents the computed details of the active/current period.

BudgetRecurrenceInterval.description:
RecurrenceInterval defines the frequency of budgeting or transaction execution rules.

 - WEEKLY: Budget resets or templates trigger every calendar week.
 - MONTHLY: Budget resets or templates trigger every calendar month.
 - YEARLY: Budget resets or templates trigger every calendar year.
 - ONE_TIME: Non-recurring single-period allocation

adjustmentDate.description: Optional. ISO timestamp of the adjustment date.

note.description: Optional. Reason or note for reconciliation.

actualAmount.description: Required. Actual amount cleared in local currency cents.

accountId.description:
Optional. Financial account identifier used to settle the payment.
When provided, the account balance will be updated accordingly.
Values are of the form `acc_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

budgetId.description:
Optional. Budget category identifier to allocate the cleared transaction under.
If omitted, defaults to the budget category configured on the scheduled payment.
Values are of the form `bud_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

currency.description:
Optional. Settlement currency code (ISO 4217 standard 3-letter code).
If omitted, defaults to the currency configured on the scheduled payment.

transactionId.description:
Required. Existing transaction identifier to match and link.
Values are of the form `txn_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

IdentityRevokeSessionBody.description: RevokeSessionRequest targets a specific session to invalidate.

identifier.description: Username or email of the user.

RecurringExpenseExecutionState.description: ExecutionState represents the scheduler engine runtime tracking parameters.

userId.description: The user ID to add as a member.

SpacesAddSpaceMemberBody.description: AddSpaceMemberRequest contains the fields for adding a member.

SpacesUpdateSpaceBody.description: UpdateSpaceRequest contains the fields for updating a workspace.

SpacesUpdateSpaceMemberRoleBody.description: UpdateSpaceMemberRoleRequest contains the fields for updating a member's role.

identityAdminV1User.description: Shared user message — mirrors the v1.User but scoped to admin context.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

saturnIdentityV1RevokeAllSessionsRequest.description: RevokeAllSessionsRequest is an empty request for global session invalidation.

Output only. Unique identifier of the account.

initialBalance.description: Required. Initial balance amount in cents (e.g. 500000 for $5,000.00).

currentBalance.description:
Output only. Computed current balance amount in cents.
Calculated dynamically as `InitialBalance + Sum(Income/TransferIn) - Sum(Expense/TransferOut)`.

creditLimit.description: Optional. Credit limit amount in cents (applicable only if CREDIT_CARD type).

v1Account.description: Account represents a physical or digital payment account.

v1AccountType.description:
Type defines the classification of payment accounts.

 - BANK: Checking or savings bank account.
 - CREDIT_CARD: Credit card account. Credit accounts support negative balances.
 - CASH: Cash balance.
 - DIGITAL_ACCOUNT: Digital wallet or virtual balance.

v1AccountView.description:

 - FULL: Hydrates complete structure including exchange rate conversion metrics.

v1BorrowingLinkType.description:
Borrowing link classification type.

 - BORROWING_LINK_TYPE_INITIAL_RECEIPT: Original funding proof ($0 balance adjustment)
 - BORROWING_LINK_TYPE_REPAYMENT: Installment payback (reduces remaining balance)
 - BORROWING_LINK_TYPE_ADDITIONAL_LOAN: Top-up / extra drawdown (increases balance)

v1TransactionType.description:
Type defines the direction and flow of funds.

 - EXPENSE: Expense transaction, subtracting from the account balance.
 - INCOME: Income transaction, adding to the account balance.
 - TRANSFER_OUT: Transfer out transaction, moving funds to another account.
 - TRANSFER_IN: Transfer in transaction, receiving funds from another account.
 - BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT: Balance adjustment transaction, reconciling account to real-world balance.
